kept.label: Access kept
kept.note: EBA-style access continues through an extension or a trade deal

gsp_plus.label: GSP+ granted
gsp_plus.note: Duty-free, but only for garments that pass two-stage rules of origin, and only if the apparel safeguard is not triggered

lost.label: Access lost
lost.note: Apparel pays the full MFN rate (standard GSP is cut for apparel because of Bangladesh's share)

regimes.after_2032: EBA ends about Nov 2032 (graduation 24 Nov 2029 + 3-year transition). Then GSP+ if granted, else MFN

regimes.today: Standard GSP until the EU-India FTA takes effect
regimes.after_2032: 0 once the FTA is in force, targeted for 2027

regimes.today: Everything But Arms, partly withdrawn in 2020
regimes.after_2032: Same clock as Bangladesh: LDC graduation scheduled for 2029
